Use the `economics` dataset from `ggplot2` package (we also explored this in the lab) produced from US economic time series data available from https://fred.stlouisfed.org/. 


```{r load data}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

data(economics, package = 'ggplot2')

ggplot(economics) +
  aes(x = date, y = psavert) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Personal Savings Rate",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Personal Savings Rate")
```
